LanguageData.MST.selectionWeightCurveComment: Curve of this arrival mode's selection weight over raid points. X axis: points, Y axis: weight.
LanguageData.MST.pointsFactorCurveComment: Actual points spent = event points × curve value (interpolated by points).
LanguageData.MST.selectionWeightCurvesPerFactionComme: Per-faction override of the selection weight curve: listed factions use their own curve, others fall back to the selection weight curve.
LanguageData.MST.forQuickMilitaryAidComment: When enabled, this mode can be used as a quick response for "call military aid".
LanguageData.MST.canBeBackupComment: Whether this mode may be chosen as a backup when the preferred mode is unavailable (tech/biome/layer restrictions, etc.).
LanguageData.MST.minSpaceSelectionWeightComment: Minimum weight required to be selected on a vacuum (space) planet layer; -1 = not applicable (vanilla default).
LanguageData.MST.layerWhitelistComment: Only allowed on these planet layers.
LanguageData.MST.layerBlacklistComment: Never used on these planet layers.
LanguageData.MST.textEnemyComment: Letter text used when a hostile faction arrives with this mode.
LanguageData.MST.textFriendlyComment: Letter text used when a friendly faction arrives with this mode.
LanguageData.MST.textWillArriveComment: Text used in the "X will arrive" letter.
